items.title: MECH-294 behavioural falsifier re-run (measurement-window fix): contaminated_harm=0.0 closes self-contamination confound that starved V3-EXQ-840
items.note: Corrects V3-EXQ-840, which FAILed its readiness gate on all 3 packet-ON arms via adequate_committed_window_sample (worst-cell n_p1_ticks_past_window: JOINT=27, ALT=6, SHUF=92 vs floor=200). A prior failure_autopsy mischaracterised the cause as sub-floor joint_route_range_supra_floor (coherence routing) -- WRONG per direct manifest read (measured 0.063841 vs floor 0.01, ~6.4x headroom; recorded as diagnosis_correction on substrate_queue.json sd_id mech294_coherence_magnitude_strengthening, corrected_by_session confident-morse-af47a8). Per-cell data shows the SAME seeds (45, 49) starved EVERY arm including ARM_0_OFF (packet off entirely), ruling out packet-ON coherence routing as cause. Root physical cause: ENV_KWARGS declared a HARM-FREE env (num_hazards=0, hazard_harm=0.0, proximity_harm_scale=0.0) but left contaminated_harm at its 0.4 default -- self-contamination (agent revisiting its own trail) is not gated by num_hazards and drained agent_health for those seeds, triggering early episode termination well before the 200-step episode budget. FIX: contaminated_harm=0.0 closes the last health-depletion route (causal_grid_world.py's step() only ends an episode from agent_health<=0 or steps>=500; with hazard cells absent and all harm scales zeroed, that can never fire within a 200-step episode), so every cell now deterministically gets the full NOMINAL_WINDOW_TICKS=3600, ~18x the floor, for every seed. Applied identically across all 4 arms (env-level parameter, not routed through binding mode) so it cannot bias C1/C2; does NOT touch compose_per_candidate_coherence or the route-range readiness floor (both confirmed working correctly by the diagnosis). Preferred over inflating STEPS_PER_EPISODE/P1_MEASUREMENT_EPISODES: that adds compute without removing the confound and stays probabilistic rather than deterministic. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (committed-action-class TV across joint/alt/shuffled with per-candidate coherence routed) checked against V3-EXQ-840 itself -- NOT recoverable (that run self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue on an inadequate sample) -- run. Smoke 2026-07-31: all 4 arms build+route+PASS at dry-run scale, no crash; validate_experiments.py --strict clean. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (Step 2.5b) reviewed: validate_queue flags a WARN citing 2 counted substrate_ceiling/non_contributory MECH-294 autopsies (failure_autopsy_569f-661-654a_2026-06-10, about the pre-2026-06-19 SCALAR-coherence defect since fixed by the per-candidate amend; failure_autopsy_batch-687a-707c-840-748a-833-842-810b-673-614-798afail_2026-07-30, whose own recommended_epistemic_category is measurement_test_design_defect -- it counted only because its recommended_substrate_queue_entry.action=create had not yet been corrected). EXEMPT: this is not a same-granularity re-test of a substrate ceiling -- the diagnosis_correction on substrate_queue.json sd_id mech294_coherence_magnitude_strengthening already established the named upstream substrate is diagnosis_corrected_no_substrate_defect (no build owed; route-range readiness independently confirmed MET at 6.4x floor). This queue entry repairs the EXPERIMENT measurement instrument, not the substrate. Follow-on chipped: correct the stale autopsy artifact action field to none/repair so the brake counter reflects this going forward.

items.title: MECH-476 INTERVAL falsifier REDESIGN: noise-scaled margin + n=10 (supersedes 836b)
items.note: Redesign of V3-EXQ-836b per failure_autopsy_v3-exq-836b_2026-07-29.md (REE_assembly 4cff1b73e8): 836b's non_monotone_interval_response verdict rested on a FIXED 0.15 margin not scaled to observed per-arm noise (per-arm SEMs 0.098-0.147 at n=6, comparable to the between-arm deltas [+0.147,+0.213,-0.157] the verdict was read from) and did not survive a leave-one-out check (the n400 peak was driven by one seed at retained_fraction=1.285 against siblings 0.202-0.934; dropping it pulls the mean 0.749->0.642, collapsing the non-monotone peak). Same measurement_test_design_defect as siblings 836 (dose) and 836c (novelty), both already redone under this rule (V3-EXQ-836a, V3-EXQ-836d) -- this queues the third and final leg of the family. Fix (both applied, IDENTICAL convention to 836a/836d): (1) RESISTANCE_INTERVAL_MARGIN replaced with a noise-scaled floor max(EFFECT_SIZE_K=1.5 * sd_delta, EFFECT_SIZE_ABS_FLOOR=0.05), sd_delta = SD of the per-seed paired (max_N-min_N) retained_fraction delta, mirroring v3_exq_824a's EFFECT_SIZE_K/ABS_FLOOR convention and matching the sibling redesigns' constants exactly for a consistent discrimination standard across MECH-476's three arms; (2) seeds 6->10 per arm (same seed tuple 42-51 as 836a/836d); (3) median reported alongside mean per arm; (4) in-line leave-one-out robustness diagnostic. STOP-CHECK / coordination (chip chip-20260729-836b-redo-noise-scaled): confirmed via experiment_queue.json + evidence/ search that 836a (dose redesign, status=claimed on ree-cloud-2 as of this queueing) and 836d (novelty redesign, supersedes 836c, status=pending) are ALREADY queued under this exact convention; neither has produced a manifest yet, so nothing here is reanalyzable from them (GOV-REUSE-1 checked -- each leg's decisive readout is leg-specific). This entry adopts the identical EFFECT_SIZE_K/ABS_FLOOR/seed-count/leave-one-out shape for cross-arm comparability. User-confirmed routing precedent: 836a/836d both cite AskUserQuestion 2026-07-29 ("Redesign re-run (noise-scaled margin + more seeds)") for the same MECH-476 family; this leg follows the same user-approved routing (failure_autopsy_v3-exq-836b_2026-07-29.md Section 7: "Routing: /queue-experiment -- 836b redo under a noise-scaled discrimination rule (same route the cluster gave 836/836c)"). GOV-REUSE-1: the noise-scaled interval-response verdict at n=10 is not recorded in any prior manifest (836b's own manifest computed it under the wrong rule and at n=6) -> must run. Re-derive brake: does not apply -- 836b's epistemic_category is measurement_test_design_defect (not substrate_ceiling) with recommended_substrate_queue_entry.action=none. Smoke PASS (validate_experiments.py --strict: 1 OK / 0 warnings; --dry-run runs end-to-end on 3 interval arms x 2 seeds toy scale, all arms readiness-gated green, correctly self-routes retention_invariant_to_interval_no_process at toy scale (spread=0.0 < effective floor 0.05), no crash; dry-run manifest written then cleaned up per the dry_run relocation contract, sentinel emitted).

items.title: ARC-005 precision-only decoupled ladder: does the control plane route PRECISION, isolated from channels 3/4's occupancy-only authority? (successor to V3-EXQ-802)
items.note: Diagnosed this session (chip-20260731-arc005-802-precision-anomaly, documented in REE_assembly/evidence/planning/arc_005_control_plane_routing_plan.md GAP-A-precision-diagnostic node): 802's joint 4-channel ladder required channels 3/4 (mode prior, pcc_stability -- never expected to touch precision, only occupancy per this plan doc's own channel table) to move precision alongside channels 1/2, diluting any real 1/2 signal with two channels structurally incapable of contributing. This experiment DECOUPLES: channels 1/2 laddered L0/L1/L2, channels 3/4 held FIXED at L0 in every cell. Also applies a real substrate bug fix landed this session (ree_core/agent.py SD-057 L7 dACC-consume block was reading get_world_state_sequence()[0,0,:], the collapsed proposer starting state identical across every candidate -- fixed by mirroring the existing ARC-065 GAP-A _candidate_world_summaries() pattern) via use_mech_consume=True + z_goal_enabled=True + candidate_summary_source='e2_world_forward', all new relative to 802. PRE-REGISTERED EXPECTATION (stated in the script's dv_symmetry_declaration): this run is expected to STILL show a near-zero null on all 10 units, for two separate already-diagnosed reasons -- channel 1's fixed wiring reaches a dacc_adapter network whose response magnitude is quantifiably negligible (~1e-8 vs ~0.87 scale of other score_bias components), consistent with the adapter never having trained on non-degenerate values of this input; channel 2 (phasic temperature) is architecturally argmax-invariant under REE's normal committed-selection regime (~97% commitment rate measured this session). A null here is a CLEAN, MECHANISTICALLY-EXPLAINED confirmation, not a surprise -- self-routes evidence_direction=non_contributory (never 'weakens' or 'mixed') when all 10 units land in the near-zero band, per the mandatory_design_check disposition for a DV-symmetry-invariant manipulation. GOV-REUSE-1: the decisive readout (precision monotonicity on a channel-1/2-ONLY ladder) does not exist in any recorded manifest -- 802 only ever varied all 4 channels together; not recoverable by reanalysis. Re-derive brake checked: 0 substrate_ceiling autopsies tag ARC-005 (one autopsy target exists, recommended_epistemic_category='standard', not a ceiling) -- not braked. TRACK B (channel 2 under an uncommitted/exploratory-only regime, the only way to let temperature matter) and TRACK C (retraining dacc_adapter on live goal_proximity) are explicitly OUT OF SCOPE here -- noted as candidate follow-on work, not built. Smoke --dry-run PASS (12 cells, 2 seeds x 3 levels x 2 contents at dry scale): all verdicts PASS, z_goal_stream active_frac=0.130 writer_calls=600 -- no writer defect (confirms the channel-1 fix's z_goal prerequisite is genuinely live), result already lands the pre-registered null pattern (all_near_zero_null=true, label=precision_channel_authority_null_expected) even at dry-run scale. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings across all checks.
items.supersedes_note: Not a lettered supersession of V3-EXQ-802 -- 802's C1/C3 occupancy result stands unchallenged. This is a new, precision-ONLY, decoupled-ladder design correcting 802's joint-ladder dilution confound on the precision DV specifically.

items.title: ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-B (H2: F-dominance) -- f_weight attenuation ladder, committed-class entropy
items.note: ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-B (H2: F-dominance, downstream of selection). Design of record: REE_assembly/evidence/planning/arc_062_conversion_fanout_2026-07-29.md Section 2 Leg P-B + "P-B buildability resolution (2026-07-31)". claim_ids=[] (diagnostic; brake-exempt per fanout doc Section 4 -- P-B tests a different mechanism from Leg P-A, claim-neutral by design; not a re-derive-brake case).  (a) GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = paired-by-seed committed-class entropy across an f_weight attenuation ladder, under the lateral_pfc-routed + CRF-ON + MECH-448/449-active matched-stack config. f_weight did not exist before V3-EXQ-852 (SD-085 landed ree-v3 main 12374fb, 2026-07-31). V3-EXQ-852 itself (ree-v3 995c7db) tested f_weight only under substrate DEFAULTS, not this leg's CRF-ON matched stack; no other manifest sweeps f_weight at all. Not recoverable by reanalysis -> proceed to author.  (b) Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): claim_ids=[], brake-EXEMPT per fanout doc Section 4 ("P-B/P-C/P-D are brake-exempt... P-B tests a different mechanism").  (c) SD-085 landing: ree-v3 main 12374fb ("SD-085: E3Config.f_weight -- weight on F (reality cost) in score_trajectory"). REE_assembly/docs/architecture/ sd_085_e3_reality_cost_weight.md. E3Config.f_weight: float = 1.0 (no-op default), multiplicative coefficient on F in E3TrajectorySelector.score_trajectory (ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py:1190). Set directly post-construction (agent.e3.config.f_weight = X), matching the lambda_ethical/rho_residue sweep idiom -- not wired through REEConfig.from_dims().  (d) CORRECTED route source: this leg's matched stack uses modulatory_channel_route_source="lateral_pfc" (V3-EXQ-851's corrected value, ree-v3 3c5d45a9dd + substrate branch in ree_core/agent.py), NOT the design doc's original literal "gated_policy" text, which V3-EXQ-851's own erratum (design doc, "Erratum (2026-07-31)" section) proved does not route the rule-apprehension/CRF channel at all.  (e) NEW C1(h) F_WEIGHT_KNOB_LIVE gate: on genuine fresh-select P2 ticks (same latch-clearing discipline as C1g), confirms mean_f_weighted falls within a +/-2% interval of f_weight * mean_f_raw (agent.e3._last_traj_components), on a majority of seeds, on EVERY rung -- i.e. the f_weight knob genuinely rescales F through the FULL matched-stack pipeline at every attenuation level, not just at substrate defaults (V3-EXQ-852's scope). C1(a-g) reused verbatim from V3-EXQ-851 (same names/thresholds) but re-scoped from "both arms" to "all four rungs" since CRF is now a matched constant ON everywhere (no OFF arm in this design); C1(d) is necessarily re-expressed as a direct magnitude floor (mean_lateral_pfc_bias_abs > PROP_NONVAC_FLOOR) rather than a paired ON/OFF diff. C1_holds requires all eight sub-gates to hold at majority-of-seeds on EVERY rung. Any C1 fail on any rung -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a verdict.  (f) DV-symmetry declaration (mandatory, 604c net): committed-class entropy is a function of the argmax action-class sequence. f_weight rescales ONE per-candidate-VARYING term (F -- not a broadcast scalar) relative to M/Phi in the score sum; neither a uniform additive shift (argmax-cancelling) nor a whole-score monotone rescale -- so it is NOT invariant under the committed-class DV's argmax symmetry and legitimately CAN change the committed argmin, at every rung.  (g) Declared-null three-branch map (NO weakens, claim_ids=[]): (1) any C1(a-h) fails on any rung -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, evidence_direction=unknown. (2) C1 holds on all 4 rungs AND C2 holds (F000-vs-F100 committed-class-entropy lift >= 0.05 nats on >=2/3 seeds) -> f_dominance_confirmed_h2_operative_ceiling, evidence_direction=non_contributory but a load-bearing GOVERNANCE ROUTING signal (ARC-062's behavioural retest should be gated behind an F-rebalance substrate landing). (3) C1 holds AND C2 fails -> f_dominance_refuted_as_sole_cause, evidence_direction=non_contributory; per the fanout doc's P-C resolution, H3 (competence/action-learning) is already "eliminated" in hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json -- this branch corroborates the already-tracked H-observation-interface root rather than reopening H3.  (h) Code review (Step 3.5): full checklist walked against the script -- claim tagging (claim_ids=[] correct for a claim-neutral diagnostic; EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE ="diagnostic" correct); diagnostic adjudication (9 preconditions C1a-h all readiness-kind with measured/threshold/met, load_bearing C2 criterion, criteria_non_degenerate for all 9); substrate API correctness (f_weight, _last_traj_components["f"]/["f_weighted"], and the "lateral_pfc" route branch independently grepped live in ree_core before writing); phased training (P0/P1/ P2 unchanged from 851); sample-size integrity (same latch-clearing idiom as 851/791a -- last_score_diagnostics cleared before every select_action, C1g and the new C1h reads both gated on the SAME fresh-select check since _last_traj_components is populated in the same score_trajectory call); progress instrumentation ([train] ep N/M with M=total_train_eps loop bound, verdict PASS/FAIL per seed*rung = 12 lines, Seed/Condition boundary lines); output contract (run_id _v3, architecture_epoch, outcome exact field, stamp_recording_core via write_flat_manifest, z_goal_stream wired via ZGoalStreamAccumulator per 852's pattern -- an improvement over 851, which leaves it NOT RECORDED); runner conformance (emit_outcome at end of __main__, dry_run threaded through). One finding during review: validate_experiments.py flagged a new anchor-reachability WARN not present on 851 (851 is experiment_purpose="evidence", which the lint skips entirely; this script is correctly "diagnostic" per the locked design, so the identically-shaped C1a-g/h preconditions newly trip it). Resolved with a documented ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT (the preconditions are live-measurement COUNT aggregates, not known-degenerate-reference anchors -- there is no predicate-vs-frozen-reference mismatch to guard against, matching the precedent set by V3-EXQ-852's own exemption reasoning for its one by-construction precondition).  (i) Smoke test (--dry-run): all 4 rungs x 1 seed complete cleanly, verdict PASS x4, manifest written+cleaned. C1/C1h correctly read False on the tiny dry-run dose (2 P2 episodes x 30 steps cannot clear the readiness floors -- expected, matches 851's own dry-run behaviour). Independently verified the C1(h) F_WEIGHT_KNOB_LIVE logic via a direct run_experiment() call: at every rung mean_f_weighted matched f_weight*mean_f_raw within the 2% interval exactly as designed (e.g. ARM_F000 f_weight=0.0 -> mean_f_weighted=0.0 bit-exact; ARM_F100 f_weight=1.0 -> mean_f_weighted==mean_f_raw exactly), confirming the knob-live check computation is correct before the real run. [smoke] z_goal_stream: active_frac=0.000 ticks=0/455 writer_calls=455 goal_state_present=True n_agents=4 -- no writer defect (correctly wired, zero active_frac expected on the tiny dry-run dose).  (j) validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings across all 19 checks (0 anchor-reachability-warnings after the ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT addition; 0 arm-fingerprint-backlog; 0 stale-e3-diagnostics; 0 precondition-recomputability; 0 dead-z_goal-stream; matches V3-EXQ-851's own fully-clean state).  Reuses V3-EXQ-851's matched-stack + C1(a-g) + latch-clearing machinery verbatim per the fanout doc's own instruction ("Leg P-B... hold the rule-apprehension channel ON and lateral_pfc-routed... as a matched constant").
